name: hos-tracker
description: HOS Tracker — Truck Hours of Service

scripts.copy: cp index.html dashboard.html manifest.json icon.png logo.png dash.png trasparente.ico icon-192.png icon-512.png apple-touch-icon.png icon-32.png icon-96.png icon-144.png sw.js hardware-permissions.js www/
scripts.build: npm run copy && (npx cap add ios 2>/dev/null || true) && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-ios-permissions.js
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.test: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && node scripts/test-hosgps.mjs && node scripts/check-www-parity.mjs
